Name: Nyapu Rupnan's Collection Remake
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[b][size=5][u]Update!![/u][/size][/b]
[b][size=4]I've deleted all my uploads for older versions of the Rupnan NPC mods. [/size][/b]
[b][size=4]This is now the only Nyapu portraits file I will maintain-- it has been updated with the new NPC Victoria, as well as some minor adjustments to the pre-existing NPCs.[/size][/b]

[b]Description[/b]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by Nyapu and Aelinore-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPCs included in the "Rupnan's Collection Remake" mod by Rupnan!

^^Apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to Nyapu and Aelinore for the assets! Credits to Rupnan for the NPC mod!

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
Unzip the download file "NyapuRupnanNPCs" and then drag the "Rupnan Collection Remake" folder into your already existing mods folder where you keep the main mod. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.
OR you can find the "portraits" folder at --[i]mods/[/i][i]Rupnan Collection Remake\[CP] Rupnan Collection Remake\Assets\Images\Portraits[/i]-- yourself and drag the replacers into it. Personally, I tend to do this just to ensure everything goes neatly where it is supposed to :P

[b]Requirements[/b]
These are REPLACERS! You need the " Rupnan's Collection Remake" mod for these to work.
